text: This report provides information and identifies a preliminary set of issues regarding the applications located at 20, 40, 50, 70, 80 and 100 Cowdray Court. Staff are currently reviewing the applications. They have been circulated to all appropriate agencies and City divisions for comment. Staff will proceed to schedule a community consultation meeting for the applications with the Ward Councillor.

Scarborough Community Council directed that: 1. Staff schedule a community consultation meeting for the applications located at 20, 40, 50, 70, 80 and 100 Cowdray Court together with the Ward Councillor. 2. Notice for the community consultation meeting be given to landowners and residents within 120 metres of the application site, and to additional residents, institutions and owners to be determined in consultation with the Ward Councillor, with any additional mailing costs to be borne by the applicant.
